title: Tools and carpentry
learning_outcomes: Explain tools and materials in the context of tools and carpentry.
Compare and distinguish measurement and joining in the context of tools and carpentry.
Apply supervised project planning in the context of tools and carpentry.
Evaluate and justify decisions about hazards in the context of tools and carpentry.

lessons.title: Tools and materials
lessons.outcome: Explain tools and materials in the context of tools and carpentry.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving tools and materials; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to low-risk project plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain tools and materials from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of tools and materials; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Measurement and joining
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish measurement and joining in the context of tools and carpentry.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving measurement and joining; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to low-risk project plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain measurement and joining from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of measurement and joining; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Supervised project planning
lessons.outcome: Apply supervised project planning in the context of tools and carpentry.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving supervised project planning; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to low-risk project plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain supervised project planning from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of supervised project planning; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Hazards
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about hazards in the context of tools and carpentry.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving hazards; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to low-risk project plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain hazards from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of hazards; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of tools and materials; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of measurement and joining; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of supervised project planning; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of hazards; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
